study.question: Can explicit same-event conjunctions of target-field matches improve the current first-order relation representation? The supplied 53-entry trajectory index contains successful runs, not failed execution receipts. The strongest early representation contrast was relation_content_counts=0.82757048 versus replica_control=0.81978673; content-only=0.82624720 and counts-only=0.82007791. Relation-specific banks also exceeded rotated controls, while adding joint feedback counts regressed (g0-r0004-joint_feedback_counts=0.82656761 versus zero_feedback_counts=0.82757048). Later feedback binding was inconsistent: feedback_bound=0.82980946 versus factorized=0.82999920; joint versus factorized memory changes sign between separate and collapsed layouts. The incumbent is joint/collapsed memory at 0.8303789179. The latest event_silu=0.8303761499, pooled_silu=0.8303331335, event_linear=0.8302301477 and pooled_linear=0.8303185690 did not surpass it; linear placements, algebraically commuting, still differ numerically. These observations favor a targeted representation contrast rather than asserting that arbitrary event nonlinearity helps. Source inspection shows six overlapping field-equality masks summarized separately in five bins; no explicit pair intersection is retained. Joint pair support/covariance in the actual data is unavailable here. The idea is motivated by this code limitation, not an invented prevalence measurement. The recorded length slices are descriptive: incumbent empty_history n6444 (buy positives13), history1_16 n461684, history17_64 n1001754, history_gt64 n1401885. Differences across those populations are not causal effects of length.
study.hypothesis: When separate target-field matches occur on different versus the same historical event, explicit pair-intersection content and occupancy can provide useful evidence beyond marginal summaries. Preserve all existing first-order, rank, feedback and static paths; add pair information as zero-start residual updates to the same relation tokens before joint interaction. An active marginal-information replacement with the same parameters tests whether any gain depends on same-event binding. The auxiliary labels match user/category/brand over24h, so category-brand conjunction is a plausible member of the fixed 15-pair family, not a claim of advertisement conversion attribution or a premeasured special case.

study.proposed_difference: For every unordered pair (r,s) of the six item-field equality masks and every one of the five temporal bins, compute C_rs=sum_i 1_r(i)1_s(i)w_i v_i/sqrt(7) and n_rs=sum_i1_r(i)1_s(i). The factorized count is n_r*n_s/max(n,1); factorized content is (n_s*C_r+n_r*C_s)/(2*max(n,1)), using recomputed FP32 marginal sums with the same signed weights and full item/action values. All four cells compute both sources in FP32, independently choose joint/factorized content and count, concatenate content with log1p(count)/log101, and project through 15 independent zero-initialized bias-free [113,32] maps shared over windows. Route each pair output to its two existing relation slots with coefficient1/sqrt5. No global-slot update, new attention key, identity token or readout dimension is introduced. Exactly54240 additional parameters are estimated from frozen six fields and embedding16; expected total33076645 and dense1283429, pending host confirmation. No random draw is introduced after inherited initialization. Zero bank gives the parent initial function algebraically; it is not an empirical parent-equivalence result. Marginal estimates are explicit controls, not an assertion that field matches are independent. This is a local experimental difference. Originality relative to the full literature remains unverified.

falsifiers: At matched content/count source, replacing joint statistics by marginal estimates yields equal or better AUC across consequential paired repetitions: no support for that conjunction component in this implementation.

Full joint beats the recorded incumbent but not the active marginal control: improvement is compatible with extra parameterization, numerical paths or optimization; same-event binding remains unsupported.

Pair intersections are almost always deterministic from marginal masks, absent, or numerically indistinguishable; the hypothesized additional information is not available at useful support. Such evidence is currently missing, not a measured null.

Outputs/gradients are nonfinite, padding/current action changes affect predictions, the zero-start function differs unexpectedly, or host costs exceed the hard trial cap: treat as integrity/implementation failure, retain charged receipts and fix before scientific interpretation.

A tiny gain smaller than variation among paired reruns or numerically equivalent controls does not establish mechanism support. Failure of this residual implementation alone does not refute all possible pair representations.
